tracks.title: The Stardust Engine
tracks.loreNote: Opens the final concert before the band's decade-long Burnout Hiatus as cosmic spotlights ignite Pier Luigi Nervi's ribbed concrete dome ceiling inside the **Norfolk Scope Arena**.

tracks.title: Progress Street: Where the Fire Began
tracks.loreNote: Brings the 2004 *Progress Street* opener down to downtown Norfolk.

tracks.title: Impact: Mile Marker 98
tracks.loreNote: Begins the *Moon 2 (Engine)* segment of the show—Ryan's visceral hard-rock confrontation with the 1990 Des Moines bus crash.

tracks.title: The Penumbra: Transit
tracks.loreNote: Ryan's heavy, high-friction highway rock anthem from 2003's *Mile Marker 98*.

tracks.title: Sanctuary: Zero-G
tracks.loreNote: Transitions from Ryan's guitar storm into Cassidy's *Moon 1 (Anchor)* zero-gravity sanctuary, turning the ribbed concrete dome ceiling of the Norfolk Scope into a glowing planetarium.

tracks.title: Deep Pressure
tracks.loreNote: Cassidy's deeply personal synth-pop tribute to the grounding power of deep-pressure hugs during autistic sensory overload.

tracks.title: The Anchor's Hold
tracks.loreNote: Completes the five-song *Twin Moons Live Suite* as Ryan and Cassidy lock Moon 1 and Moon 2 back into a single orbital system.

tracks.title: No Hidden Gravity
tracks.loreNote: **The Hometown Ghent Highlight.** Performing just blocks from Norfolk's historic Ghent neighborhood where Nate and Maya live, Ryan and Cassidy dedicate this booming power ballad to Ghent's favorite platonic safe-person duo.

tracks.title: Route 1: Midnight Headlights
tracks.loreNote: From 2004's *Progress Street*—celebrating the late-night highway miles and the custom tour coaches parked outside the Norfolk Scope Arena.

tracks.title: Before the Distance
tracks.loreNote: The emotional centerpiece of 2004's *Progress Street*, sung as a soaring sibling duet under the Scope dome.

tracks.title: Fifth Gear: The Architect's Shield
tracks.loreNote: Cassidy's tribute to younger sister and CEO Holly O'Connell—who is watching from the side of the Norfolk stage, already preparing to shut down touring operations so her exhausted siblings can rest.

tracks.title: Last Bus Home: Lights Out on Progress Street
tracks.loreNote: Before the final encore, Ryan and Cassidy sing their bittersweet farewell to the road—promising Forger Nation that while they are turning the lights out after four studio albums in four years to recharge, they *will* return one day.

tracks.title: Electric Color
tracks.loreNote: The mandatory closer—one final, cathartic explosion of color inside the Norfolk Scope Arena before the band heads home to Blacksburg for their 2005–2014 Burnout Hiatus. *(Note: By sacred band vow, 'Saturday Night Lights: The Crucible' and 'If You Walked Away' are strictly excluded).*
